decision: Reject RQ-001-N3 as a single-benchmark joint language/intervention-identifiability claim on SILG/RTFM because the benchmark does not define a latent mechanism-intervention family or ground-truth intervention partition. Retain Gate L on SILG solely as a public reproduction and language-necessity test. Defer Gate I to a bounded public-benchmark audit; prohibit architecture work until a dataset with raw language, explicit pre/post mechanism changes, intervention ground truth or justified abstraction, held-out targets and permutation-aware evaluation is found.
